nodes.text: Warm yourself and move on when you're able. Cold iron, colder nights — that's the posting.

choices.text: I broke one of the warcamps out there.
I felled one of the named terrors.

nodes.text: Quiet at the fire, loud everywhere else. Warcamps on the rises, old ruins that _don't stay quiet after dusk_, and stones out deep that folk hang names on. We hold the lamplight. Past that, the road belongs to whoever's holding it.
That was *you*? Then the road east breathes easier for a season. The Watch pays in nothing but respect — but you have all of mine.
We heard the name went quiet. Named things grow back slower than camps — you bought the frontier a real breath. Drink's on the fire, such as it is.
